name: DAG — each node is its own SCC
code:
adj = [[1], [2], []]
result = tarjan_scc(3, adj)
assert all(len(scc) == 1 for scc in result)

name: single cycle
code:
adj = [[1], [2], [0]]
result = tarjan_scc(3, adj)
assert len(result) == 1
assert sorted(result[0]) == [0, 1, 2]

name: two disjoint cycles
code:
adj = [[1, 4], [0], [3], [2], [5], [4]]
result = tarjan_scc(6, adj)
assert sorted(result) == sorted([[0, 1], [2, 3], [4, 5]])

name: single node with self-loop
code:
adj = [[0]]
result = tarjan_scc(1, adj)
assert len(result) == 1
assert result[0] == [0]

name: two nodes mutually reachable
code:
adj = [[1], [0]]
result = tarjan_scc(2, adj)
assert len(result) == 1
assert result[0] == [0, 1]
